reference_observations.description: Conditional withdrawal in main P2 superseded by reopened postscript requesting notice again if Josiah consents.

evidence.quote: upon further reflexion, I will request you to be so good as to give notice

reference_observations.description: Own December 24 note 1465F sent to Josiah yesterday, December 25; not contradictory composition/dispatch dates.

evidence.quote: I yesterday sent a note to Mr Jos. Wedgwood to be forwarded to you

reference_observations.date_policy: Yesterday relative to January 31, supplied year endorsed.

reference_observations.description: Date refers to Salt note receipt, not completed bank credit.

evidence.quote: your note received this morning, informing me that 1018£ will be paid to my account this day in London

reference_observations.description: Broken raw diag/ramme account, non-decimal columns and apparent share-price arithmetic issue; preserve witness, do not infer a prompt.
Body 84 pounds differs from apparatus 86; body income arithmetic 170 versus correspondent alleged 180 retained.

reference_observations.date_policy: Explicit this morning with supplied month/year.
reference_observations.description: Document arrived; current Owen-versus-Powis presumption corrected in 1380, not silently rewritten.

evidence.quote: I received the conclusive document this morning from you.
it applied, I presume to Major Owen’s mortgage & not to Lord Powis’s
I had a long interview with Mr Baugh yesterday

reference_observations.description: Baugh reported Commissioners approach now completed, litigation still conditional.

evidence.quote: I received your note yesterday, & this morning after breakfast I called on Mr. Baugh.
he has actually already called at the office of the Commissioners & laid the case before them!

sections.date_policy: Initial conditional withdrawal during main letter
Reopened postscript restores request; no distinct calendar date inferred

corrections.description: First-pass/editorial paid-into-account summary overstates will-be-paid body; actual bank receipt not established by note.

previously_recorded_relationships.description: Scoped Erasmus acknowledgement of statement and request, already accepted. No duplicate edge and no Darwin reading of the answer by April 26 inferred.
